description: Get a chronological (newest-first) feed of recent Canton Network activity: CIP status changes, new grant proposals, new forum threads, blog posts, GitHub releases, and radar items, merged into one time-ordered stream (default last 7 days). Canton-specific. Not a git/repo changelog. Use for 'what changed/happened on Canton recently'; use get_trending instead for popularity-ranked 'what's hot'.

days.description: How far back to look, in days, counted from now. Default 7, max 90.

limit.description: How many changes to return, newest first. Default 50, max 500.

name: get_recent_changes
